title: Can a decision model say 'none of these'? (redo)

clinc.label: CLINC150+OOS

stage_caps_note: probe 0.05 and pilot 0.25 USD for every route. full = 1.6 x the projected full-run cost in docs/map/routes.md (3,080 + 5,500 rows plus 8 warm-ups), rounded up to whole cents: luna 1.1145 -> 1.79, jev upper bracket 1.03 -> 1.65, perplexity-v1 0.4867 -> 0.78, clef 5.8568 -> 9.38, clef-flash 2.1963 -> 3.52. XOR has no list price: its price is entered as 0 so the cap never binds, and the attempt limit (4 x rows + 64) bounds the stage.

xor.env_note: as the blog's XOR runs of 5-6 Oct: scratchpad xor-demo/xor_env.sh (2 Oct) mapped LITELLM_BASE_URL and XOR_API_KEY of the main NeuroLink .env and set XOR_MODEL=jev-latest; the route is a LiteLLM deployment, and the model behind it is whatever the route serves (the response's model field is recorded)

publish_note: perplexity-v1/clinc/full was stopped by the guard after 10 failed attempts in a row (failed connections from this machine, 17 Oct 13:02-13:29 IST); it is kept in the folder and not published; full-r2 is the complete rerun. clef and clef-flash: the probe stages of 17 Oct (06:33 UTC) were rejected by Cloudflare with HTTP 401 (the token had expired on 14 Oct, notes/cloudflare-token-check.json) and are kept, not published; after the token was replaced, probe-r2 (three rows, 18 Oct 03:11 UTC) and the four full stages ran on 18 Oct UTC, a day after the other three routes
